responsibility: Declares the RL78 target command-line options and their generated option metadata. It defines CPU-selection, multiply/divide hardware-selection, simulator, register-reservation, relaxation, ES-zero, and interrupt MDUC-save options; maps aliases such as -mg10/-mg13/-mg14/-mrl78 onto mcpu; and binds the option variables and enums from rl78-opts.h so the backend can specialize code generation and target hooks according to selected RL78 hardware and runtime assumptions.
same_name_distinction: Is the generated-options source for the RL78 port: it lists target switches such as mcpu, mmul, mes0, and aliases like mg10/mg13/mg14, binding them to enums and variables in rl78-opts.h. Unlike rl78.cc, rl78.h, and rl78.md, it does not implement backend behavior or instruction semantics, but defines the user-facing option interface that controls them.
